title: Xobin Partners
text:
Ashby
Add Xobin assessments as an Ashby activity or a pipeline stage, then read qualification status and full reports without leaving Ashby.
EXPLORE
BambooHR
Map BambooHR jobs to Xobin tests once, then let candidate status changes trigger invites and write scores back into the profile.
G-sheet
Sync Xobin assessment results straight into Google Sheets for custom reporting and candidate tracking.
Google Calendar
Sync interview scheduling with Google Calendar: set availability, let candidates pick slots, and keep every event in one timeline.
Google Meet
Create interview events in Xobin and get a Google Meet link on every one, so you can join, reschedule or cancel without leaving your workflow.
Greenhouse
Integrate Greenhouse with Xobin to send assessment invites, track candidate progress, and view detailed performance reports directly inside your Greenhouse workflow.
JazzHR
Send Xobin assessments straight from JazzHR, sync scores back to the candidate record, and shortlist on evidence instead of resumes.
Keka
Install the Xobin app in Keka, send assessments from the candidate menu, and read skill-wise reports in the Feedback section.
Lever
Tie Xobin assessments to Lever pipeline stages so tests fire automatically, tags update themselves, and scores land on the opportunity.
Manatal
Move a candidate into one Manatal stage and Xobin does the rest: invite sent, score synced, profile updated, stage advanced.
Naukri
Push Xobin assessments into Naukri workflows to screen and shortlist candidates faster.
Pinpoint
A webhook, a stage and a set of custom fields: that is all it takes for Pinpoint to invite, score and tag candidates through Xobin.
Recruit CRM
Built for agencies: map jobs to assessments, trigger invites on status change, and submit candidates to clients with evidence attached.
Slack
Get instant notifications on candidate submissions, reminders, and team mentions inside Slack.
SmartRecruiters
Three ways to assess in SmartRecruiters: order a test manually, run it inline on the careers site, or auto-trigger it at a Skill Test stage.
Teamtailor
Send Xobin assessments from Teamtailor hiring stages and review assessment status, scores and reports in the candidate profile.
Tellent Recruitee
Install Xobin from the Recruitee Marketplace in seven quick steps and bring skill-based screening into collaborative hiring.
TurboHire
Connect TurboHire's AI screening with Xobin assessments in three short steps, then track every API call from the Xobin logs.
Udemy Business
Close skill gaps the moment you find them. Xobin identifies development needs, recommends Udemy Business courses and learning paths, and brings learning progress back into Xobin for a single view of capability.
Workable
Attach a Xobin assessment to any Workable job, invite candidates from their profile, and watch scores and integrity data land on the timeline.
Zapier
Connect Xobin to 5000+ apps through Zapier to automate offers, reminders, and follow-ups.
Zoho Recruit
Launch skill assessments without leaving Zoho Recruit: invite candidates, watch progress live, and see scores land right on the candidate record.
Calendly
Schedule interviews with Calendly right after candidates finish a Xobin assessment.
iCIMS
Send Xobin assessments to iCIMS candidates and sync results back to the profile.
Jobvite
Run Xobin assessments inside Jobvite and review scores on the candidate record.
LinkedIn
Assess LinkedIn applicants with Xobin and shortlist on verified skill data.
Monster
Screen Monster applicants with Xobin assessments before the first conversation.
MS Teams
Run live interviews on Microsoft Teams with Xobin assessment context attached.
TalentLyft
Trigger Xobin assessments from TalentLyft and keep candidate scores in one place.
ZappyHire
Add structured skill assessments to ZappyHire's automated hiring workflows.
Zoom
Launch Zoom interviews from Xobin and keep assessment results alongside the call.
Want to become a partner?
Join Xobin's integration partner network or explore affiliate opportunities.
Partner with us
